scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle, then returning to the original lane.
The person driving a motor vehicle on the road, including a driver who is being passed.
A person riding a bicycle on the road.
A motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped.
A designated area, identified by specific signs, overhead yellow lights and pavement markings, that lets pedestrians cross a road where there are no traffic lights.
The portion of a roadway that connects sidewalks on opposite sides into a continuous path or that has signs, lines or other markings for pedestrian crossing; it may be unmarked.
A continuous pavement line at the left of the driver's lane.
A dashed pavement line at the left of the driver's lane.
The area on each side of the vehicle, mostly to the back left and back right, that the driver cannot see in the mirrors.
A large commercial vehicle such as a tractor-trailer, truck or bus.
An orange and red sign on the rear of farm machinery or a horse-drawn vehicle warning that it travels at 40 km/h or less.
A snow-removal vehicle on a public roadway, equipped with flashing blue lights.
A centre lane of a road used by left-turning vehicles from both directions to wait for a chance to turn.
A special passing or climbing lane that lets slower vehicles move into the right-hand lane so faster ones can pass in the left lane.
A high-speed, multi-lane road with traffic in each direction separated and ramps for entering and exiting; also called an expressway.
A police, fire, ambulance or special public-utility vehicle, identified by flashing red or blue lights, a siren or bell, or alternating flashes of white light from its headlamp high beams.

rules.title: Pass only when sure it is safe
rules.when: about to PASS another vehicle
rules.action: begin the PASS
rules.unless: the PASSER is sure there is enough space and time to complete the PASS without danger to the PASSER or others
rules.statement: WHEN about to PASS another vehicle, the PASSER MUST NOT begin the PASS, UNLESS the PASSER is sure there is enough space and time to complete the PASS without danger to the PASSER or others.
rules.note: 10.1 says 'be sure you have enough space and time'; 10.15 says 'Never overtake and pass ... unless you are sure'.

rules.title: If in doubt, do not pass
rules.when: the PASSER is in doubt about whether a PASS is safe
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN the PASSER is in doubt about whether a PASS is safe, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.

rules.title: Do not race a vehicle that speeds up
rules.when: the vehicle being passed speeds up during the PASS
rules.action: go back to the original lane instead of racing it
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle being passed speeds up during the PASS, the PASSER MUST go back to the original lane instead of racing it.

rules.title: Staying behind is often safer
rules.when: deciding whether to go around a slower vehicle
rules.action: consider staying a few seconds behind it, which is often safer than going around it
rules.statement: WHEN deciding whether to go around a slower vehicle, the DRIVER SHOULD consider staying a few seconds behind it, which is often safer than going around it.

rules.title: Signal left and check before moving out
rules.when: about to move into the passing lane to PASS
rules.action: use the left-turn signal and check that the way is clear ahead and behind
rules.statement: WHEN about to move into the passing lane to PASS, the PASSER MUST use the left-turn signal and check that the way is clear ahead and behind.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.note: 10.4 and 10.19 also say never to change lanes without signalling and looking.

rules.title: Watch for hidden and entering road users
rules.when: preparing to PASS
rules.action: watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden in front of the vehicle being passed, for vehicles turning left in front, and for vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to PASS, the PASSER MUST watch for bicycles and small vehicles hidden in front of the vehicle being passed, for vehicles turning left in front, and for vehicles or pedestrians entering the road from another road or driveway.

rules.title: When to move back in
rules.when: returning to the original lane after overtaking
rules.action: signal and change lanes only once the entire front of the passed vehicle can be seen in the inside rear view mirror
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after overtaking, the PASSER MUST signal and change lanes only once the entire front of the passed vehicle can be seen in the inside rear view mirror.
rules.note: Stated for passing in general (10.19) and for passing at night (10.32).

rules.title: Do not cut in front
rules.when: moving back in front of the passed vehicle or any other vehicle, including a bicycle
rules.action: cut in front of it by moving suddenly
rules.statement: WHEN moving back in front of the passed vehicle or any other vehicle, including a bicycle, the PASSER MUST NOT cut in front of it by moving suddenly.
rules.note: 10.19 words this as advice ('Be careful not to cut off'); 10.10 and 16.35 use the stronger 'Never'/'don't', which is recorded.

rules.title: Passing parked vehicles: watch for doors
rules.when: passing parked vehicles
rules.action: watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors and for doors opened to load and unload
rules.statement: WHEN passing parked vehicles, the DRIVER MUST watch carefully for people suddenly opening doors and for doors opened to load and unload.

rules.title: No passing near a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.action: pass any vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the PASSER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.
rules.note: Stated on two pages, both times as a prohibition.

rules.title: No passing left of centreline near bridges and tunnels
rules.when: within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.action: pass left of the centreline
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, the PASSER MUST NOT pass left of the centreline.

rules.title: No passing near hill crests or blind curves
rules.when: approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve, AND the view of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety
rules.action: attempt to pass
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve, AND the view of oncoming traffic is obstructed AND there is not enough clear distance ahead to pass in safety, the PASSER MUST NOT attempt to pass.

rules.title: Do not pass a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk
rules.when: a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK
rules.action: pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle is stopped at a CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass that vehicle.
rules.note: Reason given: a stopped vehicle may be a clue that a pedestrian is crossing.

rules.title: No passing in a two-way left-turn lane
rules.when: on a road with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing
rules.statement: WHEN on a road with a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing.

rules.title: Do not go around a blocking vehicle in an intersection
rules.when: driving through an intersection AND the DRIVER's lane is blocked by a vehicle turning left or by a vehicle edging into the intersection from the right
rules.action: slow down or stop instead of pulling out to go around the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving through an intersection AND the DRIVER's lane is blocked by a vehicle turning left or by a vehicle edging into the intersection from the right, the DRIVER MUST slow down or stop instead of pulling out to go around the vehicle.
rules.note: From the Level Two road test description; the same block says not to change lanes in the intersection.

rules.title: Solid line: unsafe to pass
rules.when: there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a SOLID LINE at the left of the DRIVER's lane, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT pass.
rules.note: The handbook words this as 'it is unsafe to pass'; the line colour is not stated and the diagram is missing.

rules.title: Broken line: passing allowed
rules.when: there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS
rules.action: pass
rules.statement: WHEN there is a BROKEN LINE at the left of the PASSER's lane AND the way is clear AND enough broken line remains ahead to complete the PASS, the PASSER MAY pass.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.note: The example refers to vehicle 'A' in a missing diagram.

rules.title: Right shoulder only for a left-turning vehicle
rules.when: the right shoulder is paved AND the vehicle ahead is turning left
rules.action: drive on the right shoulder to pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the right shoulder is paved AND the vehicle ahead is turning left, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive on the right shoulder to pass that vehicle.

rules.title: No passing on the left shoulder
rules.when: passing another vehicle
rules.action: pass on the left shoulder, whether paved or not
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass on the left shoulder, whether paved or not.

rules.title: When passing on the right is allowed
rules.when: on a multi-lane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN on a multi-lane road OR on a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle, the DRIVER MAY pass on the right.
rules.note: The handbook adds that passing on the right can be more dangerous than passing on the left.

rules.title: Wait for a slower vehicle to move right
rules.when: driving in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front
rules.action: wait for the slower vehicle to move to the right instead of suddenly changing lanes to pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN driving in the leftmost lane with a slower vehicle in front, the DRIVER MUST wait for the slower vehicle to move to the right instead of suddenly changing lanes to pass on the right.
rules.note: Reason given: the driver in front may move right at the same time.

rules.title: Cyclists: one metre
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical.
rules.penalty: A fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when 1 metre is impractical

rules.note: Points to Diagram 2-11, which is not given.

rules.title: Cyclists: change lanes to pass
rules.when: passing a CYCLIST
rules.action: change lanes to pass whenever possible
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER SHOULD change lanes to pass whenever possible.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when it is possible

rules.title: No unnecessary horn when overtaking a cyclist
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST
rules.action: sound the horn unnecessarily
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST, the DRIVER MUST NOT sound the horn unnecessarily.
rules.note: Reason given: it may frighten the cyclist and cause loss of control.

rules.title: Horn use when overtaking a cyclist
rules.when: overtaking a CYCLIST AND the DRIVER feels the horn must be used
rules.action: tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away from the CYCLIST
rules.statement: WHEN overtaking a CYCLIST AND the DRIVER feels the horn must be used, the DRIVER MUST tap the horn quickly and lightly while still some distance away from the CYCLIST.

rules.title: Small vehicles: pass by changing lanes
rules.when: wanting to pass a SMALL VEHICLE, including one that has pulled to the left or right side of its lane
rules.action: pass by changing lanes, not within the same lane
rules.statement: WHEN wanting to pass a SMALL VEHICLE, including one that has pulled to the left or right side of its lane, the DRIVER MUST pass by changing lanes, not within the same lane.
rules.note: 10.24 says a small vehicle moving aside is not an invitation to pass in the same lane; 6.50 says motorcycles use a full lane.

rules.title: Left turn behind a small vehicle
rules.when: making a left turn behind a SMALL VEHICLE
rules.action: stay behind it without pulling up beside it, turn when the way is clear, and wait for it to move right before passing
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn behind a SMALL VEHICLE, the DRIVER MUST stay behind it without pulling up beside it, turn when the way is clear, and wait for it to move right before passing.

rules.title: Large vehicles: do not cut in close
rules.when: passing a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: cut in front of it closely
rules.statement: WHEN passing a LARGE VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST NOT cut in front of it closely.
rules.note: Reason given: large vehicles need a much longer distance to stop. The same block advises allowing more room (PASS-USER-08).

rules.title: Large vehicles: allow more room
rules.when: passing a LARGE VEHICLE
rules.action: allow more room
rules.statement: WHEN passing a LARGE VEHICLE, the PASSER MUST allow more room.
rules.note: 6.61 adds that turbulence from a large vehicle may affect control when passing it.

rules.title: Farm machinery: stay back until safe
rules.when: seeing a vehicle with a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN, such as farm machinery
rules.action: slow down, be cautious, stay well back and not pass until it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN seeing a vehicle with a SLOW-MOVING VEHICLE SIGN, such as farm machinery, the DRIVER MUST slow down, be cautious, stay well back and not pass until it is safe to do so.

rules.title: Horse-drawn vehicles: pass only when safe
rules.when: following a horse-drawn vehicle
rules.action: pass it
rules.unless: it is safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN following a horse-drawn vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass it, UNLESS it is safe to do so.
rules.note: The same block says to slow down, be very cautious and keep a safe following distance.

rules.title: Horse-drawn vehicles: maximum distance
rules.when: passing a horse-drawn vehicle
rules.action: leave as much distance between the vehicle and the horse-drawn vehicle as possible
rules.statement: WHEN passing a horse-drawn vehicle, the PASSER MUST leave as much distance between the vehicle and the horse-drawn vehicle as possible.
rules.note: Reason given: passing too closely could startle the horse.

rules.title: Never pass moving snow plows
rules.when: behind a moving SNOW PLOW
rules.action: pass it under any conditions
rules.statement: WHEN behind a moving SNOW PLOW, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass it under any conditions.

rules.title: Do not pass between staggered snow plows
rules.when: several SNOW PLOWS are staggered across a FREEWAY clearing lanes
rules.action: try to pass between them
rules.statement: WHEN several SNOW PLOWS are staggered across a FREEWAY clearing lanes, the DRIVER MUST NOT try to pass between them.
rules.note: Reason given: not enough room, and the ridge of snow can throw the vehicle out of control.

rules.title: Pass streetcars on the right
rules.when: passing a streetcar
rules.action: pass on the right
rules.statement: WHEN passing a streetcar, the DRIVER MUST pass on the right, UNLESS driving on a one-way road.

rules.title: Streetcar stops: stay 2 metres back
rules.when: a streetcar is at a stop where passengers are getting on or off
rules.action: stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors
rules.unless: an area has been set aside for streetcar passengers at the stop
rules.statement: WHEN a streetcar is at a stop where passengers are getting on or off, the DRIVER MUST stay at least 2 metres behind the rear doors, UNLESS an area has been set aside for streetcar passengers at the stop.

rules.title: Streetcar safety islands: reasonable speed
rules.when: passing a streetcar stop with a safety island or an area set aside for passengers
rules.action: pass at a reasonable speed and be ready for pedestrians to make sudden or unexpected moves
rules.statement: WHEN passing a streetcar stop with a safety island or an area set aside for passengers, the DRIVER MUST pass at a reasonable speed and be ready for pedestrians to make sudden or unexpected moves.

rules.title: Roadside workers: slow down and pass with caution
rules.when: roadside assistance, disabled vehicles, surveyors, road maintenance or utility workers are on the road
rules.action: slow down and pass with caution
rules.statement: WHEN roadside assistance, disabled vehicles, surveyors, road maintenance or utility workers are on the road, the DRIVER MUST slow down and pass with caution.

rules.title: Roadside workers: move over a lane
rules.when: passing roadside assistance, disabled vehicles, surveyors, road maintenance or utility workers on the road
rules.action: move over a lane to increase the space between the vehicle and the hazard
rules.unless: it is not safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN passing roadside assistance, disabled vehicles, surveyors, road maintenance or utility workers on the road, the DRIVER MUST move over a lane to increase the space between the vehicle and the hazard, UNLESS it is not safe to do so.

rules.title: Stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck: slow down
rules.when: approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing OR a stopped tow truck with its amber lights flashing
rules.action: reduce speed and proceed with caution, braking early and gradually
rules.statement: WHEN approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing OR a stopped tow truck with its amber lights flashing, the DRIVER MUST reduce speed and proceed with caution, braking early and gradually.
rules.penalty: A fine and three demerit points for a first offence; higher fines and up to six months in jail for further offences.
rules.note: The demerit table lists 'Failing to slow and carefully pass a stopped emergency vehicle' at three points.

rules.title: Stopped emergency vehicle or tow truck: move over
rules.when: approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing OR a stopped tow truck with its amber lights flashing, AND the road has two or more lanes in the DRIVER's direction
rules.action: signal, check mirrors and BLIND SPOTS, and change into a lane away from the stopped vehicle well in advance
rules.unless: it is not safe to do so
rules.statement: WHEN approaching, in the DRIVER's direction of travel, a stopped EMERGENCY VEHICLE with its red, or red and blue, lights flashing OR a stopped tow truck with its amber lights flashing, AND the road has two or more lanes in the DRIVER's direction, the DRIVER MUST signal, check mirrors and BLIND SPOTS, and change into a lane away from the stopped vehicle well in advance, UNLESS it is not safe to do so.
rules.penalty: A fine and three demerit points for a first offence; higher fines and up to six months in jail for further offences.

rules.title: Keep right unless passing
rules.when: driving on a road, including a multi-lane road or FREEWAY
rules.action: keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane
rules.unless: turning left OR passing another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN driving on a road, including a multi-lane road or FREEWAY, the DRIVER MUST keep to the right of the road or in the right-hand lane, UNLESS turning left OR passing another vehicle.
rules.note: 5.13 is a plain command; 12.20 and 12.24 word the freeway version as 'should' and 'when possible'. Especially important when driving more slowly than other vehicles.

rules.title: Do not stay in the freeway passing lane
rules.when: having used the far left lane of a multi-lane FREEWAY to pass traffic moving slower than the speed limit
rules.action: stay in the far left lane
rules.statement: WHEN having used the far left lane of a multi-lane FREEWAY to pass traffic moving slower than the speed limit, the DRIVER MUST NOT stay in the far left lane.

rules.title: Passing and climbing lanes
rules.when: on a road with a PASSING LANE
rules.action: use the right-hand lane if slower and the left lane if passing
rules.statement: WHEN on a road with a PASSING LANE, the DRIVER SHOULD use the right-hand lane if slower and the left lane if passing.
rules.note: Inferred from the handbook's description of what these lanes are for; an advance sign (image missing) announces them.

rules.title: Merge when the passing lane ends
rules.when: in the right-hand lane of a PASSING LANE section AND a sign warns that the lane is ending
rules.action: begin to merge safely with traffic in the left-hand lane
rules.statement: WHEN in the right-hand lane of a PASSING LANE section AND a sign warns that the lane is ending, the DRIVER SHOULD begin to merge safely with traffic in the left-hand lane.
rules.note: Described rather than commanded; the sign image is missing.

rules.title: Move right and let faster traffic pass
rules.when: faster traffic wants to pass the DRIVER
rules.action: move to the right and let it pass in safety
rules.statement: WHEN faster traffic wants to pass the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST move to the right and let it pass in safety.
rules.note: 10.25 is a plain command; the sample test question (28.22, answer 28.26) uses 'must', which is recorded.

rules.title: Do not speed up when being passed
rules.when: another driver is trying to pass the DRIVER
rules.action: speed up or drive so as to prevent the other vehicle from passing
rules.statement: WHEN another driver is trying to pass the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST NOT speed up or drive so as to prevent the other vehicle from passing.
rules.note: 10.20 calls speeding up unlawful; 23.22 lists driving to prevent another vehicle from passing as aggressive driving subject to sanctions.

rules.title: Being passed on an undivided road
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road where the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: pay attention to oncoming traffic and move closer to the right side of the lane
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road where the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane, the DRIVER MUST pay attention to oncoming traffic and move closer to the right side of the lane.

rules.title: Slow to let the passer in
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road where the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: be prepared to slow down to let the PASSER get in front more quickly to prevent a collision
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road where the PASSER has pulled into the opposite lane, the DRIVER MUST be prepared to slow down to let the PASSER get in front more quickly to prevent a collision.

rules.title: Clear the truck passing lane
rules.when: on a high-speed road with three or more lanes in each direction where trucks are not allowed in the far left lane AND the DRIVER is in the lane next to the far left lane AND a truck wants to pass
rules.action: move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN on a high-speed road with three or more lanes in each direction where trucks are not allowed in the far left lane AND the DRIVER is in the lane next to the far left lane AND a truck wants to pass, the DRIVER MUST move into the right-hand lane as soon as possible.

rules.title: Pass with great care at night
rules.when: passing another vehicle at night
rules.action: be very careful and pass only if the PASSER has to and the way is clear
rules.statement: WHEN passing another vehicle at night, the PASSER SHOULD be very careful and pass only if the PASSER has to and the way is clear.

vague_terms.explanation: no gap or sight distance given

rules.title: Low beams when approaching from behind
rules.when: approaching a vehicle from behind to pass it at night
rules.action: switch the headlights to low beams
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a vehicle from behind to pass it at night, the PASSER MUST switch the headlights to low beams.

rules.title: High beams when alongside
rules.when: pulling out to pass at night
rules.action: signal, check mirrors and BLIND SPOT, and switch on the high beams on moving alongside the vehicle being passed
rules.statement: WHEN pulling out to pass at night, the PASSER MUST signal, check mirrors and BLIND SPOT, and switch on the high beams on moving alongside the vehicle being passed.
rules.note: Reason given: lets the PASSER see more of the road ahead.

rules.title: Low beams within 60 metres unless passing
rules.when: less than 60 metres behind another vehicle
rules.action: use low-beam headlights
rules.statement: WHEN less than 60 metres behind another vehicle, the DRIVER MUST use low-beam headlights, UNLESS passing that vehicle.
rules.penalty: Two demerit points for failing to lower headlight beam.
rules.note: Applies to all roads, including divided ones. The passing exception fits PASS-NIGHT-03 (high beams once alongside).

rules.title: No passing in fog
rules.when: driving in fog
rules.action: pass other vehicles or speed up to pass a vehicle moving slowly
rules.statement: WHEN driving in fog, the DRIVER MUST NOT pass other vehicles or speed up to pass a vehicle moving slowly.
rules.note: 14.19 words this as advice ('Avoid passing'); 14.31 and 14.35 use 'Don't', which is recorded.

rules.title: No passing in blowing snow or whiteouts
rules.when: driving in blowing snow or a whiteout
rules.action: attempt to pass a vehicle moving slowly
rules.statement: WHEN driving in blowing snow or a whiteout, the DRIVER MUST NOT attempt to pass a vehicle moving slowly.
rules.note: 14.68 words this as advice ('Avoid passing'); 14.76 uses 'Don't attempt', which is recorded.

rules.title: Towing: enough time and room before passing
rules.when: about to pass another vehicle
rules.action: make sure there is enough time and room to complete the PASS
rules.statement: WHEN about to pass another vehicle, the PASSER towing a trailer MUST make sure there is enough time and room to complete the PASS.
rules.note: Reason given: a vehicle with a trailer accelerates more slowly and is much longer.

rules.title: Towing: do not cut back too soon
rules.when: returning to the original lane after a PASS
rules.action: allow more room before moving back and not cut back into the lane too soon
rules.statement: WHEN returning to the original lane after a PASS, the PASSER towing a trailer MUST allow more room before moving back and not cut back into the lane too soon.
rules.note: Reason given: cutting back too soon can make the trailer sway.

rules.title: Towing: let a line of traffic pass
rules.when: holding up a line of traffic
rules.action: signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass
rules.statement: WHEN holding up a line of traffic, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST signal, pull over and let the other vehicles pass.

rules.title: Towing: passed by a large bus or truck
rules.when: a large bus or truck passes AND its wind pushes the trailer to the side
rules.action: brake, and instead carefully steer the vehicle and trailer back into position
rules.statement: WHEN a large bus or truck passes AND its wind pushes the trailer to the side, the DRIVER towing a trailer MUST NOT brake, and instead carefully steer the vehicle and trailer back into position.
rules.note: The same block says a slight increase in speed may help.
